method: Read each finding location from its original committed content. All matched public 40-hex token addresses, explicit file SHA-256 provenance entries, or one angle-bracket README placeholder. Raw findings remain redacted and unsuppressed; no allowlist or history rewriting. This is pattern-scan triage, not proof that every possible secret is absent.
